findings.current: For one brief instant, it swallowed the narrow gorge whole. Then, from within the enormous cloud of dust, two gusts of wind blew.
findings.defect: The draft makes the shock wave, rather than the dust cloud, engulf the gorge.
findings.rationale: The subject of 집어삼킨 is 그 거대한 먼지구름.
findings.replacement: An enormous cloud of dust swallowed the narrow gorge in an instant. From within it, two gusts of wind blew.
findings.source: 그리고 찰나의 순간 비좁은 협곡을 집어삼킨 그 거대한 먼지구름 사이로, 두 줄기의 바람이 불었다.

findings.current: That tiny trickle—barely more than a handful—was all the North Heaven Demon Lord had managed to draw. The Master and Disciple didn’t let the opportunity slip.
findings.defect: “Barely more than a handful” reverses the stated amount.
findings.rationale: 한 줌도 되지 않는 means less than a handful.
findings.replacement: That tiny trickle—not even a handful—was all the North Heaven Demon Lord had managed to draw. The Master and Disciple didn’t let the opportunity slip.
findings.source: 불과 한 줌도 되지 않는 그 미량의 핏물만이 북천마군이 취할 수 있었던 모든 것이었고, 두 스승과 제자는 기회를 놓치지 않았다.

findings.current: The cold air of dawn—and the moisture in it—vaporized in an instant.
findings.defect: The draft says the air itself vaporizes; the source specifies the moisture in it.
findings.rationale: 그 안에 스며든 습기가 identifies the moisture as what evaporates.
findings.replacement: The moisture in the cold dawn air evaporated in an instant.
findings.source: 새벽의 찬 공기가, 그 안에 스며든 습기가 단숨에 증발한다.

findings.current: There was no time to choose another option, much less find one.
findings.defect: The draft turns a lack of available choices into a lack of time to choose.
findings.rationale: The first clause rules out any remaining choice; the second rules out time to find a new one.
findings.replacement: There were no choices left, not even time to look for another.
findings.source: 더 이상 선택의 여지도, 새로운 선택지를 찾을 시간조차 없다.

findings.current: And as the North Heaven Demon Lord endured that instant of pain and stumbled backward in a desperate retreat, the spearhead he had abandoned flashed toward him in search of a new master.
findings.defect: The draft leaves the spear searching for a master, whereas the source says it has found one.
findings.rationale: 새로운 주인을 찾은 describes a completed change of wielder.
findings.replacement: And as the North Heaven Demon Lord endured that instant of pain and stumbled backward in a desperate retreat, the spearhead that had left him for a new master flashed toward him.
findings.source: 그리고 찰나의 고통을 감내하며 다급하게 뒷걸음질 치는 북천마군을 향해, 그를 떠나 새로운 주인을 찾은 창날이 번뜩였다.

findings.current: He burst through the churning dust cloud, launching himself off the cliff face and into open air.
findings.defect: The draft omits his stepping on the air as well as the cliff face.
findings.rationale: 암벽과 허공을 밟으며 makes both the cliff face and empty air surfaces he steps on.
findings.replacement: He burst through the churning dust cloud, bounding off the cliff face and the very air.
findings.source: 휘몰아치는 먼지구름을 뚫고, 암벽과 허공을 밟으며 쏘아졌다.

findings.current: A blinding, brilliant flame swallowed the darkness. The North Heaven Demon Lord instinctively looked up, his eyes turning white with its light.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the binding rendering of 광염 with a generic flame.
findings.rationale: The packet’s glossary renders 광염 as “light-flames.”
findings.replacement: Blinding light-flames swallowed the darkness. The North Heaven Demon Lord instinctively looked up, his eyes turning white with their light.
findings.source: 눈부신 광염(光焰)이 어둠을 집어삼킨다. 본능적으로 고개를 든 북천마군의 두 눈동자를 새하얗게 물들였다.

summary: Several action and quantity details change in the draft; one established term is also missing.
